title: Vegetable and Cashew Kitchri
subtitle: with brown basmati and fine rice noodles
description: Brown basmati rice cooked with saffron and whole spices, then mixed with fried capsicum, carrot, cashews and crisp rice vermicelli. Serve with fresh coriander and yoghurt.

steps.text: Cook the rice in a pot of plenty of boiling water for 15 minutes until slightly softened, then drain.
Meanwhile, soak the rice noodles in hot water for about 15 minutes until soft. Drain and pat dry with paper towel.

Heat the oil in a wide pot and stir-fry the diced capsicum, chilli, carrot, onion, cashews and spices for 2-3 minutes until golden. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the rice noodles, fry for 2-3 minutes, remove and set aside.

Add the rice to the spiced oil and stir for a minute. Pour in enough boiling water to cover, add salt and return to the boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 15-20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Mix the rice with the reserved vegetables, cashews and noodles. Serve topped with chopped coriander and with yoghurt.
